verses.text: The LORD said to me, "Take a large writing tablet and write on it in plain letters: 'Maher Shalal Hash Baz.'"
"And I will call reliable witnesses to confirm it: Uriah the priest, and Zechariah son of Jeberekiah."
Then I went to the prophetess, my wife, and she became pregnant and gave birth to a son. The LORD said to me, "Name him 'Maher Shalal Hash Baz.'
For before the boy knows how to say 'My father' or 'My mother,' the riches of Damascus and the treasures of Samaria will be carried off by the king of Assyria."
The LORD spoke to me again and said,
"These people have rejected the gently flowing waters of Shiloah, and they are glad about Rezin and the son of Remaliah.
So look, the Lord is about to bring against them the mighty flood waters of the Euphrates River, the king of Assyria with all his power. It will rise over all its channels and run over all its banks.
It will sweep on into Judah, flooding and rising up to the neck. Its spreading wings will cover the whole width of your land, Immanuel!"
Raise the battle cry, you nations, and be shattered! Listen, all you distant lands: get ready for battle and be shattered! Get ready for battle and be shattered!
Make your plans together, but they will come to nothing. Give your orders, but they will not stand, for God is with us.
The LORD spoke to me with his strong hand on me, and he warned me not to follow the ways of this people. He said,
"Do not call everything a plot that these people call a plot. Do not fear what they fear, and do not be terrified.
The LORD of Armies is the one you must treat as holy. He is the one you should fear. He is the one you should dread.

He will be a holy place of safety. But for both kingdoms of Israel he will be a stone that makes people stumble and a rock that makes them fall. And for the people of Jerusalem he will be a trap and a snare.
Many of them will stumble. They will fall and be broken. They will be trapped and captured."
Wrap up this message as a witness. Seal up this teaching among my followers.
I will wait for the LORD, who is hiding his face from the people of Jacob. I will put my hope in him.
Here I am, with the children the LORD has given me. We are signs and wonders in Israel from the LORD of Armies, who lives on Mount Zion.
People will say to you, "Ask the mediums and the spiritists, who whisper and mutter." But should not a people ask their God? Why ask the dead on behalf of the living?
Go to God's teaching and his warning! If they do not speak according to this word, there is no light of dawn for them.
They will wander through the land, deeply troubled and hungry. When they are hungry, they will become angry and curse their king and their God. They will look up toward heaven,
and then look down at the earth, and they will see only trouble, darkness, and frightening gloom. They will be thrown out into deep darkness.
